The apps compile these same sources under THEIR configs (they link de_shell/js into the Electron project and alias @de/shell-* to <target>/index.ts), so what is set here has to be a subset of what they allow: moduleResolution bundler, and .ts extensions in relative imports (the unit tests run under node --test's native type stripping, which resolves relative imports literally).
